components.name: Ink Primary Button
components.description: Compact primary action for operating surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 20px; color: #f4f1ea; background: #20201d; font: 600 14px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #b34e33; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2457c5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Paper Field
components.description: Labeled control with a quiet translucent fill over paper.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #20201d; font: 600 12px/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(32 32 29 / 20%); border-radius: 12px; color: #20201d; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 50%); font: 400 16px/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: rgb(32 32 29 / 45%); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2457c5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Language Switcher
components.css: .ds-language { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid rgb(32 32 29 / 20%); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 35%); } .ds-language button { border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; color: rgb(32 32 29 / 70%); background: transparent; font: 600 12px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-language button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #f4f1ea; background: #20201d; } .ds-language button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2457c5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Editorial Tool Row
components.description: Full-width home-page destination in place of a card grid.
components.html: Interactive music theorySee structures on exact keys and hear them immediately.
components.css: .ds-tool-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(13rem,.8fr) minmax(18rem,1.2fr) 48px; gap: 20px; align-items: center; min-height: 144px; padding: 28px 24px; border-block: 1px solid rgb(32 32 29 / 20%); color: #20201d; background: transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-tool-row strong { font: 400 34px/1.1 Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-tool-row span { max-width: 65ch; font: 400 15px/1.75 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tool-row svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; padding: 12px; overflow: visible; border: 1px solid rgb(32 32 29 / 25%); border-radius: 50%; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-tool-row:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 30%); } .ds-tool-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2457c5; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Diatonic Chord Choice
components.description: A complete structural choice showing degree, numeral, root, and quality.
components.css: .ds-chord-choice { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 52px 1fr auto; gap: 9px; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 8px 13px; border: 1px solid rgb(32 32 29 / 14%); border-radius: 4px; color: #20201d; background: transparent; font-family: "Noto Serif SC", Georgia, serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chord-choice strong { font-size: 21px; } .ds-chord-choice small { color: #626d59; } .ds-chord-choice[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #b34e33; background: rgb(179 78 51 / 8%); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 #b34e33; } .ds-chord-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2457c5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Piano Key
components.description: Terracotta key with a non-color chord-role marker.
components.css: .ds-piano-key { position: relative; display: flex; width: 64px; height: 116px; align-items: end; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 4px; border: 1px solid rgb(32 32 29 / 32%); border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px; color: #fff; background: #b34e33; font: 600 12px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-role { position: absolute; bottom: 34px; display: grid; width: 20px; height: 20px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 9px; } .ds-piano-key:hover { background: #9f3f27; } .ds-piano-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2457c5; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Flight should feel like a carefully edited personal workroom: warm enough to invite exploration, precise enough to trust with real tasks, and quiet enough that each experiment remains the subject. Independent tools own their composition while warm paper, near-black ink, deliberate hierarchy, restrained accents, semantic HTML, and clearly authored interaction states hold the family together.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper grounds every light surface.
Ink rules and spacing establish hierarchy before cards or shadows.
One terracotta signal and one muted moss support state and context.
Editorial type is wide, readable, and paired with compact utilitarian labels.
Each tool owns its layout while remaining visibly part of the same collection.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: A surface may deepen terracotta or moss for contrast, but it does not introduce a second decorative accent family.

rules.name: The Contrast Pair Rule
rules.body: Small text must use the accessible signal or moss variants; the lighter shared variants are not acceptable merely because the hue looks correct.

rules.name: The Wide Heading Rule
rules.body: A display heading should read as one decisive shape and never collapse into six short decorative lines.

rules.name: The Page-Owned Frame Rule
rules.body: Routing chooses the surface but does not render a shared visual header, shell, or mandatory tool chrome.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: If two surfaces do not physically overlap, separate them with space, tone, or a rule instead of a shadow.

dos: Do let each tool choose the layout that best serves its task.
Do establish hierarchy with type, spacing, and ink rules before adding containers.
Do use self-hosted fonts when a feature depends on a distinctive editorial face.
Do keep links semantic, focus visible, small text WCAG AA, and mobile touch targets usable.
Do make selected states understandable through text or shape as well as color.
donts: Don't add a global visual header merely because the project has multiple routes.
Don't turn tools into generic card dashboards, bento grids, or marketing landing pages.
Don't introduce gradients, glass, heavy shadows, fake proof, or ornamental metrics without a product reason.
Don't use gamified progress, gates, streaks, or badges for exploratory learning surfaces.
Don't invent a new accent hue when a darker accessible variant of the shared palette will work.
